name: Running Genie : AI Running Coach
tagline: What it does Running Genie is an AI running coach that adapts your training to real life
description: What it does Running Genie is an AI running coach that adapts your training to real life. It connects with Strava, Garmin, Apple Health, Polar, and Suunto, reads your activity history, and turns that data into personalized coaching, pace zones, and adaptive training plans — from your first 5K to marathon and ultra preparation. Key benefits - Plans adjust week by week based on completed runs, training load, recovery signals, and race goals — not a fixed template - Built on proven training ideas:
